descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Cup Strike is an engaging physics-based shooting experience built for immersive play. Step into a dynamic virtual environment where your aim and focus are put to the test as you target towers of stacked cups placed at different distances.

[media]

Each shot delivers satisfying, realistic physics—watch cups tumble, scatter, and collapse based on your accuracy and angle. The game rewards precision and strategy, making every hit feel impactful and every miss a chance to improve.

[media]

Players can personalize their experience by adjusting sky colors, changing cup patterns, and modifying tower distances to control difficulty. Whether you want a relaxed aiming session or a more challenging setup, the game adapts to your play style.
[media]

Instant tower reset keeps gameplay smooth and uninterrupted, allowing continuous practice or competitive score chasing without delays.


With multiple environments and newly added scenes, Cup Strike VR offers variety and visual freshness across gameplay sessions. The combination of simple mechanics, responsive controls, and immersive physics creates an experience that is easy to pick up yet hard to put down.

Whether you're looking to unwind or compete for the highest score, Cup Strike VR delivers a satisfying and addictive VR gameplay loop.
